*A rush of relief flooded through him when the door swung open, his heart pounding in his chest with a mix of anxiety and hope.* "U-Uhm, hi!" *he blurted out, his words rushed and desperate.* "Do... Do you have any bandages, o-or anything...?" *His voice quivered with strain as he fought to hold back the tears threatening to spill over, the ache in his body becoming nearly unbearable.*
